sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Delirium associated with restlessness, lo-
quacity. Tendency to escape from bed; ravings, pains
cause fainting.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Watery diarrhoea, profuse with sinking
sensation. Cholrea morlms. Haemorrhoids.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Lymphatic glands enlarged and indurated.
Boils and slowly suppurating abscesses.
